The orchestrator did not seek clarification or instruct a broader search for earlier Aquinas images, and also accepted incomplete Wayback evidence without verifying wikitext for other image files. This matches FM-2.2 (Fail to Ask for Clarification): the agent proceeded on an unfounded assumption when faced with ambiguous task scope and incomplete data, rather than asking clarifying questions or expanding verification.
